name: Visa / Mastercard credit and debit cards
why: METI: 2024 cashless ratio 42.8%, credit cards 82.9% of cashless value (116.9 trillion yen); Uber Taxi Japan accepts credit cards, cash and PayPay.

name: PayPay
why: 2024: 7.46B payments, about 2/3 of all code payments and about 1 in 5 cashless payments; 75M users (Aug 2026). Uber Taxi Japan accepts PayPay since Dec 2021.

name: JCB
why: Japan's only international card brand: 181M+ cardmembers, 72M merchants (Mar 2026); Adyen acquires JCB locally in Japan; Uber Taiwan lists JCB with Visa and Mastercard.

name: Apple Pay
why: Uber Japan lists credit/debit cards, PayPay, Apple Pay and cash as payment options; Apple Pay supported in Japan per Apple's country list.

name: GMO Payment Gateway
why: Largest domestic online PG: about 20 trillion yen processed per year (company blog, Nov 2025). Route to domestic cards, PayPay, Rakuten Pay, konbini. Yuno: in code, not live.

name: Adyen (local acquiring Japan)
why: Local acquiring in Japan since May 2021 with direct connections to Visa, Mastercard, JCB, Amex, Diners, Discover, UnionPay; transactions processed locally.

name: Rakuten Pay
why: MMD Mar 2024 (22,797 smartphone owners): 25.9% use Rakuten Pay, 19.4% name it main QR service (#2 after PayPay). SBPS offers it online. Not confirmed on Uber JP.

name: SB Payment Service (SoftBank)
why: SoftBank group PSP, 11.4 trillion yen annual volume, 40+ brands incl. PayPay online, Rakuten Pay, Merpay, carrier billing, konbini. Yuno: in code, not live.

name: Google Pay
why: Google lists Japan under pay online or in apps; secondary to Apple Pay and PayPay for in-app rides. No public share figure.

name: d払い (d Barai, NTT Docomo)
why: MMD Mar 2024: 21.2% use d払い, 16.2% main QR service (#3). Carrier-linked wallet; not confirmed on Uber JP.

name: NTT DATA CAFIS
why: Japan's largest card payment platform by connections and volume (since 1984) linking PSPs, merchants, card companies and banks; the backbone behind domestic acquirers.

name: au PAY (KDDI)
why: MMD Mar 2024: 11.3% main QR service (#4); PayPay, Rakuten Pay, d払い and au PAY together are 93.2% of main-use QR payers.

name: Sony Payment Services (renamed SP.LINKS, Oct 2025)
why: Sony Bank PSP, 50+ payment methods; payments partner of the S.RIDE taxi app (7 code payments) and a taxi JV. No public volume figure. Yuno: in code, not live.

name: Merpay (Mercari)
why: Outside MMD's top four QR services (no public share figure); offered online as メルペイネット決済 by SB Payment Service. Marginal for rides.

name: Korean domestic cards (Shinhan, Samsung, KB, Hyundai, Lotte, BC, Hana, NH) via a local PG
why: Uber Korea: fares payable only with a Korea-issued credit or debit card registered in the app (2020). Kakao T auto-pay is card-only with 11 domestic issuers listed. Needs a Korean PG.

name: KG Inicis
why: One of the top 4 PGs that hold 65 to 70% of Korea's 150+ PG market (PortOne, Dec 2025); PGs bundle Kakao Pay and Toss into one integration with unified settlement.

name: NHN KCP
why: Top 4 PG (65 to 70% combined share, PortOne Dec 2025); KCP PAY adds cards, account transfer and carrier billing. Yuno: in code (cards and bank transfer), not live.

name: Toss Payments
why: Claims #1 domestic PG by transaction value with 100,000+ merchants; cards, simple pays, overseas cards, PayPal, billing keys. Top 4 PG per PortOne.

name: NICE Payments
why: Top 4 PG (NICE Information and Telecommunication group) with 65 to 70% combined share; online plus offline terminal coverage (PortOne, Dec 2025).

name: Naver Pay
why: Q2 2024 payments 17.5 trillion won, offline 2.6 trillion won (+82% YoY); BoK H1 2024 simple pay 939.2 billion won per day. Not confirmed on Kakao T or Uber Taxi.

name: Kakao Pay
why: Kakao's own wallet; auto-payment applied to Kakao Taxi Black from 2015 (Kakao press). Kakao Pay offline volume +131% YoY in Q2 2024. Kakao T is the dominant ride app.

name: Visa / Mastercard (international acceptance)
why: Uber Taxi Korea (UT) registers credit/check cards and gift cards; foreign-issued cards were excluded by Uber Korea in 2020, so Visa/MC matter mainly as domestic co-badged cards.

name: Samsung Pay
why: Contactless offline plus online via the Samsung Pay button in apps and sites; no public payment-share figure. Yuno: in code, not live.

name: Toss Pay
why: Toss claims 30 million users reachable via Toss Pay for online and offline merchants; no ride-hailing acceptance evidence found.

name: Apple Pay
why: Hyundai Card still the only Apple Pay issuer as of Jul 2026; Shinhan and KB undecided; needs NFC terminals. In-app Apple Pay works only for Hyundai cardholders.

name: Payco (NHN)
why: NHN points and payment wallet; no public share figure and no ride-hailing acceptance evidence found.

name: Bank transfer / virtual account (계좌이체) via PG
why: Offered by Toss Payments and other PGs, but Kakao T auto-pay is card-only, so A2A is not a rides rail. Yuno: in code via KCP.

name: Google Pay
why: South Korea is not in Google's list of countries where you can pay online or in apps with Google Pay.

name: Visa / Mastercard / JCB via Taiwan onshore acquiring
why: Uber Taiwan moved to onshore billing on 7 Dec 2020: Visa, Mastercard and JCB trips without the bank's overseas-card fee. Uber TW blog (May 2025): cash, credit card, Apple Pay, LINE Pay.

name: LINE Pay
why: 13.1M+ users (NowNews, Sep 2025); since 17 Apr 2025 the only mobile payment accepted on both Uber and Uber Eats in Taiwan.

name: Apple Pay
why: Uber Taiwan blog (26 May 2025): cash, credit card, Apple Pay and LINE Pay all accepted for rides; Apple lists Taiwan as supported.

name: ECPay (綠界科技)
why: Self-described third-party payment leader; Visa/Mastercard/JCB domestic cards, Apple Pay, TWQR, UnionPay, foreign cards, 99.85% card success rate. Yuno live.

name: CTBC Bank (中國信託)
why: #1 card bank: 9.25M cards and NT$68.0bn monthly billing (Oct 2024, FSC data via Bnext). Acquiring share not public; domestic cards switch via NCCC.

name: JKOPAY (街口支付)
why: FSC Jul 2025: 6,976,647 users, #2 e-payment operator; not accepted on Uber (LINE Pay is the only wallet there). Trust issues reported mid-2025.

name: Google Pay
why: Google lists Taiwan for pay online or in apps; supported by NewebPay and TapPay; not named in Uber Taiwan's payment list.

name: NewebPay (藍新金流)
why: One integration to all banks' credit cards plus Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay, Taiwan Pay, LINE Pay, E.Sun Wallet. No public share figure.

name: TapPay (Cherri Tech)
why: 20,000+ stores; one API to multiple acquiring banks and card networks, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Visa/MC tokens, 3DS2. No public share figure.

name: Cathay United Bank (國泰世華)
why: #2 by monthly billing NT$67.4bn and 7.43M cards (Oct 2024); no public acquiring share figure.

name: E.Sun Bank (玉山)
why: #2 by cards 7.46M, NT$53.4bn monthly billing (Oct 2024); also an e-payment operator with 3.06M users (FSC Jul 2025). No public acquiring share.

name: Global Payments Asia-Pacific (ex HSBC JV)
why: GPAP (HSBC's former acquiring JV) covers Taiwan among its markets and is HSBC's preferred acquiring provider in APAC (2012). Yuno has Global Payments live in Taiwan.

name: iPASS MONEY (一卡通)
why: FSC Jul 2025: 7,016,659 users, #1 e-payment account; transit-card linked, no ride-hailing app acceptance found.

name: Taiwan Pay / TWQR (FISC bank QR)
why: Bank-backed debit QR run by FISC; offered by NewebPay and ECPay (TWQR). No public share figure; not on Uber.

name: Visa / Mastercard credit cards
why: Uber HK metered taxi (Sep 2023): credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal accepted; Pair & Pay (Jul 2026): credit card, Uber Cash or in-app wallets.

name: AlipayHK
why: Uber HK added AlipayHK as a bindable payment method in Nov 2023; 42% e-wallet share per Worldpay 2025 (Fintech News HK), 150,000+ outlets.

name: Apple Pay
why: Accepted on Uber HK (metered taxi post); 22% share cited from Worldpay (Fintech News HK, Jan 2026).

name: HSBC / Global Payments Asia-Pacific
why: HSBC's card acquiring sits in GPAP (JV since 2006, HQ Hong Kong, 45,000 outlets at formation); HSBC's preferred acquiring provider in APAC after the 2012 sale.

name: Adyen (local acquiring Hong Kong)
why: Adyen lists Hong Kong among its local acquiring markets (with Australia, NZ, Malaysia, Singapore) in its 2021 release. Yuno has Adyen live elsewhere, not in HK.

name: Google Pay
why: Accepted on Uber HK (metered taxi post); Google lists Hong Kong for pay online or in apps.

name: Octopus
why: 36M+ cards, 15M transactions/day, 98% penetration (15 to 64), 210,000+ acceptance points; 27,000 taxi drivers on Octopus terminals, but not an in-app Uber method.

name: PayMe by HSBC
why: About 3M users; accepted by HK taxis via the Octopus solution since Dec 2024; no evidence of acceptance inside Uber HK.

name: WeChat Pay HK
why: About 5M+ users incl. visitors (Eats365, Feb 2026); accepted in taxis via Octopus; no Uber HK acceptance evidence.

name: PayPal
why: Listed by Uber HK as an accepted electronic payment for metered taxi rides (Sep 2023). Not in Yuno's HK method list.

name: Stripe
why: Hong Kong site with HK$ pricing; local acquiring or HK wallets not confirmed on the page opened. No public share figure.

name: Checkout.com
why: Lists Alipay for China and Hong Kong; HK local acquiring not confirmed on the page opened. No public share figure.

name: FPS (Faster Payment System)
why: 18M+ registrations and 2M+ transactions/day (Oct 2025, FSTB); bank and SVF rail, not used as an in-app rides method by Uber HK.

name: UnionPay
why: Accepted in HK taxis via Octopus QR since 25 Jan 2024 (21,000 drivers); mainly visitor cards, not in Yuno's HK list.
